tickets.title: Shipping coupon applied twice in checkout totals
context: Customers reported confusing coupon totals where the shipping discount appears twice.
The issue reproduces when the checkout recalculates totals after changing shipping method.
acceptanceCriteria: A shipping coupon adjustment is applied at most once per checkout session.
Displayed totals match the authorized payment intent amount.
Regression test exists for the reproduction scenario.
openQuestions: Should shipping discounts reduce cobbler payout, or is payout calculated from pre-discount shipping revenue?
